The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions (blur/noise), which aligns with the image being a clear photo of a statue/diorama rather than a raw AI generation with compression artifacts. The severity of the small model's defect is significant enough to lower the artifact score substantially, despite the main subject being relatively clean.
